statBlock.name: Bugbear
statBlock.description: A bugbear waits out of sight until a target comes close enough for a heavy first blow.

sections.Traits:
Brute. On a hit with a melee weapon, roll one extra weapon damage die. The attacks below already include it where applicable.
Surprise Attack. If the bugbear surprised a creature, its hits against that creature in the first round of combat deal an extra 7 (2d6) damage.
sections.Actions:
Morningstar. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage.
Javelin. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage in melee or 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage when thrown.

statBlock.name: Gnoll
statBlock.description: This hyena-headed raider closes on its next prey as soon as its first target falls.

sections.Traits: Rampage. On its turn, if the gnoll drops a creature to 0 HP with a melee attack, it can spend a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make one Bite attack.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) with a two-handed melee attack.
Longbow. Ranged weapon attack, +3 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

statBlock.name: Goblin
statBlock.description: A shield and a shortbow let the goblin harry travelers and duck back into cover.

sections.Traits: Nimble Escape. The goblin can Disengage or Hide as a bonus action on each of its turns.
sections.Actions:
Scimitar. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.
Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

statBlock.name: Hobgoblin
statBlock.description: An armored hobgoblin works with its allies to punish any foe they pin in place.

sections.Traits: Martial Advantage. Once per turn, when the hobgoblin hits a creature with a weapon, it can deal an extra 7 (2d6) damage if one of its allies is within 5 ft. of the target and is not Incapacitated.
sections.Actions:
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d8 + 1) slashing damage, or 6 (1d10 + 1) if wielded with two hands.
Longbow. Ranged weapon attack, +3 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

statBlock.name: Kobold
statBlock.description: A kobold fights best with allies close by, away from direct sun.

sections.Traits:
Sunlight Sensitivity. While the kobold is in sunlight, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that use sight.
Pack Tactics. The kobold has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if an ally within 5 ft. of that creature is not Incapacitated.
sections.Actions:
Dagger. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
Sling. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

statBlock.name: Lizardfolk
statBlock.description: Lizardfolk make armor and tools from hides, shells, and bones. They can approach a fight underwater.

sections.Traits: Hold Breath. The lizardfolk can go up to 15 minutes without taking a breath.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two melee attacks, each with a different weapon.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Heavy Club. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
Javelin. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Spiked Shield. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

statBlock.name: Orc
statBlock.description: This lightly armored warrior carries a greataxe for close combat and a javelin for targets farther away.

sections.Traits: Aggressive. The orc can use a bonus action to move up to its speed toward a hostile creature it can see.
sections.Actions:
Greataxe. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 9 (1d12 + 3) slashing damage.
Javelin. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

statBlock.name: Grimlock
statBlock.description: An eyeless Underdark hunter that tracks prey by sound and scent.

sections.Senses: Blindsight 30 ft., reduced to 10 ft. while Deafened. The grimlock is blind beyond that radius. Passive Perception 13.
sections.Traits:
Blind Senses. The grimlock loses its blindsight if it is both Deafened and unable to smell.
Keen Hearing and Smell. The grimlock has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.
Stone Camouflage. The grimlock has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide in rocky terrain.
sections.Actions: Spiked Bone Club. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) piercing damage.
